title: 短链接服务
description: 设计短链接创建、跳转和过期服务。
functionalRequirements: 创建短链接并跳转
自定义别名与链接过期
滥用链接处理
scaleRanges: 每日新增 100万–1000万 链接
reliabilityConstraints: 跳转 p99 低于 100 ms
deepDiveDirections: 标识符生成与碰撞
热点缓存与数据库分片
缓存失效和故障回源

en.title: URL Shortener
en.description: Design link creation, redirection and expiration.
functionalRequirements: Create links and redirect
Custom aliases and expiration
Handle abusive links
scaleRanges: 1–10 million new links per day
Read/write ratio 20:1–100:1; retain for 1–5 years
reliabilityConstraints: Redirect p99 below 100 ms
Redirect availability target 99.9%–99.99%
deepDiveDirections: Identifier generation and collisions
Hot-key caching and database partitioning
Invalidation and fallback under failure

title: 优惠券与秒杀
description: 设计限量优惠券领取与订单确认系统。
functionalRequirements: 限量领取与每人限领
订单确认或超时释放
查询领取结果
scaleRanges: 活动 10万–100万 用户
峰值 1万–10万 次领取请求/秒；库存 1万–10万
reliabilityConstraints: 不允许超卖或重复领取
领取接口 p99 低于 300 ms；允许明确排队结果
deepDiveDirections: 库存原子扣减与幂等
队列积压与背压
预留过期和补偿对账

en.title: Coupons and Flash Sales
en.description: Design limited coupon claims and order confirmation.
functionalRequirements: Limited inventory and per-user limits
Confirm orders or release expired reservations
Query claim results
scaleRanges: 100k–1 million participants
10k–100k peak claim requests/s; 10k–100k items
reliabilityConstraints: No overselling or duplicate claims
Claim p99 below 300 ms; explicit queued outcomes allowed
deepDiveDirections: Atomic inventory updates and idempotency
Queue backlog and backpressure
Reservation expiry and reconciliation

title: 聊天与实时消息
description: 设计支持离线消息的一对一及小群聊天服务。
functionalRequirements: 发送与接收文本消息
会话内顺序与离线补拉
已送达状态和多端同步
scaleRanges: 100万–1000万 日活用户
每人每日 20–100 条消息；群人数上限 100
reliabilityConstraints: 在线消息送达 p99 低于 500 ms
已确认消息不可静默丢失；允许重传后去重
deepDiveDirections: 连接网关与路由
顺序、投递和去重
断线重连与多端游标

en.title: Chat and Realtime Messaging
en.description: Design direct and small-group chat with offline delivery.
functionalRequirements: Send and receive text messages
Per-conversation order and offline catch-up
Delivery receipts and multi-device sync
scaleRanges: 1–10 million daily active users
20–100 messages/user/day; up to 100 users/group
reliabilityConstraints: Online delivery p99 below 500 ms
Acknowledged messages must not silently disappear; retry and deduplication allowed
deepDiveDirections: Connection gateways and routing
Ordering, delivery and deduplication
Reconnect and per-device cursors

title: 动态信息流
description: 设计关注关系下的发帖与时间线服务。
functionalRequirements: 发布动态与关注用户
分页读取时间线
删除动态和隐私可见性
scaleRanges: 100万–1000万 日活用户
每人每日发帖 1–5 次、读时间线 10–50 次
reliabilityConstraints: 时间线读取 p99 低于 300 ms
动态允许秒级延迟，隐私和删除语义需明确
deepDiveDirections: 推拉与混合扇出
大 V 热点与分页稳定性
删除传播和缓存一致性

en.title: Activity Feed
en.description: Design posting and timelines based on follow relationships.
functionalRequirements: Publish posts and follow users
Paginated timeline reads
Post deletion and privacy visibility
scaleRanges: 1–10 million daily active users
1–5 posts and 10–50 timeline reads/user/day
reliabilityConstraints: Timeline read p99 below 300 ms
Seconds of feed lag allowed; explicitly define privacy and deletion semantics
deepDiveDirections: Push, pull and hybrid fan-out
Celebrity hot spots and stable pagination
Deletion propagation and cache consistency

title: 分布式任务队列
description: 设计带重试和可见性超时的后台任务服务。
functionalRequirements: 提交与领取任务
确认、重试与死信
延迟任务及执行状态查询
scaleRanges: 典型执行时间 1–60 秒；任务保留 7 天
reliabilityConstraints: 确认提交后不能静默丢任务
至少一次投递；执行方须处理重复
deepDiveDirections: 租约、心跳和重复执行
公平调度与背压
存储分区与故障恢复

en.title: Distributed Task Queue
en.description: Design background tasks with retries and visibility timeouts.
functionalRequirements: Submit and claim tasks
Acknowledge, retry and dead-letter
Delayed tasks and execution status
scaleRanges: 1k–10k tasks/s
Typical execution 1–60 seconds; retain tasks for 7 days
reliabilityConstraints: No silent loss after submission acknowledgement
At-least-once delivery; workers handle duplicates
deepDiveDirections: Leases, heartbeats and duplicate execution
Fair scheduling and backpressure
Storage partitions and recovery

title: 文件存储与多端同步
description: 设计支持断点续传、版本历史和离线修改的个人文件同步服务。
functionalRequirements: 上传、下载和分块断点续传
跨设备变更同步与版本历史
文件分享、撤销分享与删除
scaleRanges: 100万–1000万 日活用户；每人每日上传或修改 5–20 个文件
平均变更文件 2–10 MB，单文件上限 10 GB；历史版本保留 30 天
reliabilityConstraints: 元数据操作 p99 低于 300 ms；完整文件传输时间按文件大小与带宽另算
成功确认的版本须持久化；离线并发修改不可静默覆盖，撤销分享的传播边界需明确
deepDiveDirections: 内容分块、元数据提交与孤儿块回收
变更日志、设备游标与冲突副本
跨租户去重泄漏、权限校验和恢复点目标

en.title: File Storage and Multi-Device Sync
en.description: Design personal file sync with resumable uploads, version history and offline edits.
functionalRequirements: Upload, download and resume chunked transfers
Sync changes across devices and retain versions
Share files, revoke access and delete
scaleRanges: 1–10 million daily active users; 5–20 uploaded or modified files/user/day
Mean changed file size 2–10 MB, maximum file size 10 GB; keep old versions for 30 days
reliabilityConstraints: Metadata operation p99 below 300 ms; estimate full-file transfer time separately from size and bandwidth
Acknowledged versions must be durable; no silent overwrites of concurrent offline edits; define access-revocation propagation
deepDiveDirections: Content chunks, metadata commits and orphan cleanup
Change logs, device cursors and conflict copies
Cross-tenant deduplication leakage, authorization and recovery-point objectives

title: 视频上传与点播
description: 设计从上传、异步转码到自适应码率播放的视频点播平台，不含直播。
functionalRequirements: 大文件上传与处理状态查询
生成多档码率与播放清单
鉴权播放、下架与观看进度
scaleRanges: 每日上传 1万–10万 条视频；平均每条 10 分钟、原始码率 8 Mbps
10万–100万 峰值同时观看；平均下发码率 2–5 Mbps，视频保留 1 年
reliabilityConstraints: 在约定网络条件下首帧 p95 低于 2 秒；播放成功率目标 99.9%
未完成转码的版本不可发布；下架内容的清单和 CDN 缓存失效时限需明确
deepDiveDirections: 上传与转码状态机、重复任务和失败重试
切片、码率阶梯与 CDN 回源流量
原片、转码副本存储与撤销权限的成本

en.title: Video Upload and On-Demand Streaming
en.description: Design upload, asynchronous transcoding and adaptive playback for on-demand video, excluding live streams.
functionalRequirements: Upload large files and query processing state
Produce bitrate variants and playback manifests
Authorize playback, remove content and resume viewing
scaleRanges: 10k–100k uploads/day; mean duration 10 minutes at source bitrate 8 Mbps
100k–1 million peak concurrent viewers; mean delivery bitrate 2–5 Mbps; retain videos for one year
reliabilityConstraints: First frame p95 below two seconds under agreed network conditions; playback success target 99.9%
Do not publish incomplete transcodes; define removal deadlines for manifests and CDN caches
deepDiveDirections: Upload/transcode state machines, duplicate jobs and retries
Segments, bitrate ladders and CDN origin traffic
Source/variant storage and access-revocation costs

title: 搜索词自动补全
description: 设计按输入前缀返回热门搜索词的服务，不包含完整网页搜索或个性化推荐。
functionalRequirements: 前缀查询与前 10 条建议
从搜索事件更新热门度并过滤违规词
支持多语言词表与租户隔离
scaleRanges: 1000万–1亿 个候选词；平均每词 30 字节文本，计数与索引额外估算
峰值 1万–10万 次前缀请求/秒；每日 1亿–10亿 条搜索事件
reliabilityConstraints: 建议查询 p99 低于 100 ms；可用性目标 99.9%
热门度允许 5 分钟延迟；违规词删除需在 1 分钟内影响在线建议
deepDiveDirections: 前缀索引分区、热门前缀缓存与内存预算
事件聚合、索引快照构建与版本切换
新鲜度与查询延迟、删除优先级和降级策略

en.title: Search Autocomplete
en.description: Design popular search suggestions by prefix, excluding full web search and personalized recommendations.
functionalRequirements: Return the top ten suggestions for a prefix
Update popularity from search events and filter blocked terms
Support multilingual dictionaries and tenant isolation
scaleRanges: 10–100 million candidate terms; mean text size 30 bytes/term, with counters and indexes estimated separately
10k–100k peak prefix requests/s; 100 million–1 billion search events/day
reliabilityConstraints: Suggestion query p99 below 100 ms; availability target 99.9%
Popularity may lag by five minutes; blocked-term removal must affect online results within one minute
deepDiveDirections: Prefix-index partitions, popular-prefix caches and memory budgets
Event aggregation, index snapshots and version swaps
Freshness vs latency, deletion priority and degradation

title: 多渠道通知平台
description: 设计支持站内信、邮件和移动推送的多租户通知平台。
functionalRequirements: 提交单发或批量通知并查询状态
按用户偏好、免打扰时段和模板发送
计划发送、取消与失败重试
scaleRanges: 每日 1000万–1亿 条逻辑通知；平均每条触发 1–3 个渠道投递
峰值为平均 10 倍；状态记录每条 500 字节、保留 30 天，正文另算
reliabilityConstraints: 提交接口 p99 低于 200 ms；即时通知正常负载下 99% 在 30 秒内完成首次供应商调用
已受理通知不得静默丢失；供应商受理不等于用户已收到，过期通知不应无限重试
deepDiveDirections: 扇出、渠道队列隔离与租户配额
幂等键、供应商超时和状态回调对账
偏好变更、取消竞争和端到端投递语义

en.title: Multi-Channel Notification Platform
en.description: Design a multi-tenant platform for inbox messages, email and mobile push.
functionalRequirements: Submit individual or bulk notifications and query status
Apply preferences, quiet hours and templates
Schedule, cancel and retry delivery
scaleRanges: 10–100 million logical notifications/day; mean 1–3 channel deliveries per notification
Peak load ten times average; 500 bytes/status record retained for 30 days, excluding message bodies
reliabilityConstraints: Submission p99 below 200 ms; at normal load 99% of immediate notifications reach their first provider attempt within 30 seconds
No silent loss after acceptance; provider acceptance is not user receipt, and expired notifications must not retry forever
deepDiveDirections: Fan-out, isolated channel queues and tenant quotas
Idempotency, provider timeouts and callback reconciliation
Preference changes, cancellation races and end-to-end delivery semantics

title: 大规模网页爬虫
description: 设计对公开网页进行增量抓取、去重与内容存储的爬虫平台。
functionalRequirements: 维护 URL 待抓队列与发现新链接
遵守 robots 规则和按站点限速
内容去重、重抓计划和失败重试
scaleRanges: 每日抓取 1000万–1亿 个页面；平均压缩后内容 100 KB
最多 1000万 个站点；原始页面保留 30 天，URL 元数据单独估算
reliabilityConstraints: 已入队 URL 可在故障后恢复；允许至少一次抓取并去重
每站点并发和请求间隔须可配置；站点拒绝与 robots 获取失败的处理策略需明确
deepDiveDirections: 抓取前沿分区、站点公平性和热点域名
URL 规范化、循环链接与内容去重
DNS、重定向与 SSRF 隔离，以及重抓新鲜度成本

en.title: Large-Scale Web Crawler
en.description: Design incremental crawling, deduplication and storage of public web pages.
functionalRequirements: Maintain a URL frontier and discover links
Respect robots rules and per-site rate controls
Deduplicate content, schedule recrawls and retry failures
scaleRanges: 10–100 million pages/day; mean compressed content size 100 KB
Up to ten million sites; retain raw pages for 30 days and estimate URL metadata separately
reliabilityConstraints: Queued URLs must recover after failure; at-least-once fetching with deduplication is allowed
Configure per-site concurrency and request spacing; explicitly handle site rejection and failure to retrieve robots rules
deepDiveDirections: Frontier partitions, site fairness and hot domains
URL normalization, link cycles and content deduplication
DNS/redirect handling, SSRF isolation and recrawl freshness costs

title: 指标采集与告警平台
description: 设计多租户时序指标写入、查询和告警服务，不包含全文日志检索。
functionalRequirements: 采集带标签的指标样本
按时间窗口聚合查询与仪表盘展示
告警规则执行、去重与通知
scaleRanges: 10万–100万 个采集目标，每个目标 100 个活跃序列，每 15 秒采样一次
每样本按 16 字节未压缩数据估算，不含标签索引；原始数据保留 15 天
reliabilityConstraints: 已确认写入可恢复；重复或乱序样本的接纳边界需定义
最近 1 小时聚合查询 p95 低于 2 秒；规则每 30 秒评估，定义数据延迟下的告警行为
deepDiveDirections: 时间序列分片、写入日志与标签基数限制
分层存储、降采样与跨分片聚合
写入背压、租户隔离和告警恢复后的重放语义

en.title: Metrics Ingestion and Alerting
en.description: Design multi-tenant time-series ingestion, queries and alerts, excluding full-text log search.
functionalRequirements: Collect labelled metric samples
Aggregate time windows and serve dashboards
Evaluate alert rules, deduplicate and notify
scaleRanges: 100k–1 million scrape targets, each with 100 active series sampled every 15 seconds
Assume 16 uncompressed bytes/sample excluding label indexes; retain raw data for 15 days
reliabilityConstraints: Acknowledged writes must recover; define acceptance boundaries for duplicate and out-of-order samples
Last-hour aggregate query p95 below two seconds; evaluate rules every 30 seconds and define behavior under ingestion lag
deepDiveDirections: Series partitioning, write-ahead logs and label-cardinality limits
Storage tiers, downsampling and cross-partition aggregation
Ingestion backpressure, tenant isolation and alert replay after recovery

title: 多人协作文档
description: 设计支持多人实时编辑和离线重连的纯文本协作文档服务。
functionalRequirements: 创建文档、共享权限与同时编辑
离线修改重连合并与版本历史
在线光标与文档导出
scaleRanges: 100万–1000万 日活用户；10万–100万 峰值编辑连接
每个活跃连接每秒 1–5 次编辑操作、每次约 200 字节；单文档最多 50 人同时编辑
reliabilityConstraints: 同区域在线编辑传播 p95 低于 200 ms；已确认操作须持久化
分区后重连需收敛且不可静默丢失已确认编辑；权限撤销的离线写入边界需明确
deepDiveDirections: 文档路由、连接网关与持久操作日志
OT 或 CRDT 与中心序列器的跨组件取舍
快照压缩、历史回收与长期离线客户端兼容

en.title: Collaborative Text Documents
en.description: Design realtime plain-text collaboration with offline reconnection.
functionalRequirements: Create/share documents and edit concurrently
Merge offline edits on reconnect and retain history
Show presence cursors and export documents
scaleRanges: 1–10 million daily active users; 100k–1 million peak editing connections
Each active connection emits 1–5 edits/s at about 200 bytes/edit; up to 50 concurrent editors/document
reliabilityConstraints: Same-region edit propagation p95 below 200 ms; acknowledged operations must be durable
Reconnect after partitions must converge without silently losing acknowledged edits; define offline writes after permission revocation
deepDiveDirections: Document routing, connection gateways and durable operation logs
Cross-component trade-offs of OT/CRDT vs central sequencing
Snapshots, history compaction and long-offline client compatibility

title: 附近司机与实时派单
description: 设计按位置查找附近司机并完成叫车匹配的服务，不含路径规划和计费。
functionalRequirements: 司机上报位置与在线状态
乘客查询附近司机并发起叫车
司机接单、取消与匹配状态查询
scaleRanges: 10万–100万 在线司机，每 3 秒上报一次位置，每次约 100 字节
峰值每秒 1000–10000 次叫车；位置查询量为叫车量 10 倍，历史位置保留 7 天
reliabilityConstraints: 附近司机查询 p99 低于 300 ms；正常负载下派单决定 p95 低于 3 秒
每位司机只能有一个有效行程；允许位置短暂陈旧，但重复派单不可只靠地理索引防止
deepDiveDirections: 地理分区与移动司机跨格更新
候选召回、司机预留与超时重新匹配
热点区域扩容、位置新鲜度和一致性权衡

en.title: Nearby Drivers and Ride Dispatch
en.description: Design location lookup and ride matching, excluding routing and billing.
functionalRequirements: Receive driver locations and availability
Find nearby drivers and request rides
Accept/cancel matches and query ride state
scaleRanges: 100k–1 million online drivers reporting every three seconds at about 100 bytes/update
1k–10k peak ride requests/s; location queries ten times ride requests; retain location history for seven days
reliabilityConstraints: Nearby lookup p99 below 300 ms; at normal load dispatch decisions p95 below three seconds
At most one active trip per driver; slightly stale locations are allowed, but a spatial index alone must not prevent double assignment
deepDiveDirections: Geographic partitions and movement across cells
Candidate retrieval, driver reservations and rematching timeouts
Hot-area scaling, location freshness and consistency trade-offs

title: 选座与票务预订
description: 设计演出票的座位查询、限时预留和购票确认服务。
functionalRequirements: 查询座位图与可售状态
限时预留座位和确认订单
取消、预留过期与订单结果查询
scaleRanges: 每场 1万–10万 个座位；同时售卖 10–100 场活动
单场开售峰值每秒 1万–10万 次座位查询、1000–10000 次预留；预留有效期 5 分钟
reliabilityConstraints: 同一座位不得对应两个已确认订单；座位图可有明确的短暂陈旧
预留接口 p99 低于 500 ms；外部支付回调可能重复、延迟或晚于预留过期
deepDiveDirections: 活动分区、热点座位与权威预留事务
订单、支付结果和库存状态机对账
排队准入、过期释放与晚到成功回调补偿

en.title: Seat Reservation and Ticket Booking
en.description: Design seat availability, temporary holds and booking confirmation for events.
functionalRequirements: Query seat maps and availability
Hold seats temporarily and confirm orders
Cancel, expire holds and query booking outcomes
scaleRanges: 10k–100k seats/event; 10–100 events selling concurrently
Per-event opening peaks of 10k–100k seat-map queries/s and 1k–10k hold requests/s; holds last five minutes
reliabilityConstraints: A seat must not have two confirmed bookings; seat maps may have explicitly bounded staleness
Hold request p99 below 500 ms; external payment callbacks may duplicate, lag or arrive after hold expiry
deepDiveDirections: Event partitions, hot seats and authoritative hold transactions
Reconciling order, payment-result and inventory state machines
Admission queues, expiry release and compensation for late success callbacks

title: 多租户分布式限流
description: 设计供 API 网关使用的多租户配额和突发流量控制服务。
functionalRequirements: 按租户和接口配置速率及突发额度
网关查询并扣减额度，返回允许或拒绝
策略热更新、使用统计与租户隔离
scaleRanges: 100万 个租户；全局峰值每秒 100万–1000万 次限流判定
100–1000 个网关实例；单个热点租户最高占总流量 10%，统计保留 7 天
reliabilityConstraints: 同区域附加判定延迟 p99 低于 5 ms；判定可用性目标 99.99%
配额精度、故障放行或拒绝、跨区域超额上界必须显式约定，不能同时默认全局精确与分区下无阻塞
deepDiveDirections: 按键分片、热点隔离与网关本地额度租赁
原子扣减、时间来源与策略版本传播
集中计数与分区额度的精度、延迟和可用性取舍

en.title: Multi-Tenant Distributed Rate Limiter
en.description: Design quotas and burst control for API gateways across tenants.
functionalRequirements: Configure per-tenant and per-endpoint rates and burst budgets
Gateways check/decrement budgets and receive allow/deny decisions
Hot-update policies, report usage and isolate tenants
scaleRanges: One million tenants; 1–10 million peak decisions/s globally
100–1000 gateway instances; a hot tenant may produce 10% of total load; retain usage statistics for seven days
reliabilityConstraints: Same-region added decision latency p99 below five milliseconds; decision availability target 99.99%
Explicitly agree quota precision, fail-open/fail-closed behavior and cross-region overshoot bounds; do not assume exact global quotas with nonblocking partitions
deepDiveDirections: Key partitioning, hot-tenant isolation and gateway quota leases
Atomic consumption, time sources and policy-version propagation
Precision, latency and availability of central counters vs partitioned budgets

title: 订单、支付与超时关闭
description: 设计从下单、库存预留、支付到履约的订单平台，处理超时关闭与晚到支付结果。
functionalRequirements: 创建和查询订单，管理库存预留与订单状态
接收可信支付结果，处理重复和乱序通知
到期关闭未支付订单，处理晚到支付、退款与对账
scaleRanges: 每日 100万–1000万 笔订单；峰值为日均创建速率的 10–30 倍
每笔订单基础记录 2 KB，保留 1 年；每单另有 5–20 条平均 500 B 的状态事件
reliabilityConstraints: 已确认的支付不能静默丢失，重复通知不能导致重复入账或重复履约
创建订单可用性训练目标 99.95%；允许订单与支付状态短暂不一致，但须定义收敛时限
deepDiveDirections: 订单、库存与支付的权威状态、事务边界和事件契约
截止时间、延迟调度、晚到支付与补偿工作流
按订单分片、热点商品隔离、对账和故障恢复

en.title: Orders, Payments and Expiration
en.description: Design an order platform from creation and stock reservations through payment and fulfillment, including expiration and late payment outcomes.
functionalRequirements: Create/query orders and manage stock reservations and order states
Accept verified payment outcomes and handle duplicate or reordered events
Expire unpaid orders and handle late payment, refunds and reconciliation
scaleRanges: 1–10 million orders/day; peak creation rate is 10–30 times the daily average
2 KB/order retained for one year; additionally 5–20 events/order averaging 500 B each
reliabilityConstraints: Confirmed payments must not disappear silently; duplicates must not double-credit or double-fulfill
Local training target: 99.95% order-creation availability; define a convergence bound for temporary order/payment disagreement
deepDiveDirections: Authoritative order, inventory and payment states, transaction boundaries and event contracts
Deadlines, delayed scheduling, late payments and compensation workflows
Order partitioning, hot-product isolation, reconciliation and recovery

title: 实时排行榜与赛季结算
description: 设计支持实时分数更新、Top N、个人排名和赛季结算的排行榜平台。
functionalRequirements: 接收可校验且可去重的积分事件，更新多个赛季榜单
查询 Top N、用户排名及附近名次，定义同分规则
冻结赛季结果并处理迟到事件、撤销和异常积分
scaleRanges: 1000万 注册用户，每日 100万–500万 活跃用户；峰值 1万–10万 次积分事件/秒
100 个活动榜单，每个榜单 10万–1000万 条排名；每条基础数据按 64 B 估算，不含索引和副本
reliabilityConstraints: 榜单查询 p99 低于 150 ms 为本地训练目标；正常情况下更新到可见不超过 3 秒
冻结结果可重建、可审计；故障后不能靠重放让同一事件重复加分
deepDiveDirections: 事件权威日志、去重状态与排名索引的数据流
精确全局名次与分区聚合的成本和新鲜度权衡
热点榜单、赛季快照、回放恢复和作弊事件撤销

en.title: Real-Time Leaderboards and Season Settlement
en.description: Design live score updates, top-N and personal rank queries, and auditable season settlement.
functionalRequirements: Validate and deduplicate score events across seasonal boards
Query top N, personal rank and neighbors with a defined tie rule
Freeze season results and handle late, reversed or suspicious scores
scaleRanges: 10 million registered users and 1–5 million daily active users; 10k–100k score events/s at peak
100 active boards with 100k–10m entries each; estimate 64 B of base data/entry before indexes and replicas
reliabilityConstraints: Local targets: rank-query p99 below 150 ms and normal update visibility within three seconds
Frozen results must be rebuildable and auditable; recovery replay must not double-apply events
deepDiveDirections: Authoritative event log, deduplication state and ranking-index data flow
Costs and freshness trade-offs of exact global ranks versus partition aggregation
Hot-board isolation, season snapshots, replay recovery and score reversals

title: 登录、会话与权限平台
description: 设计服务于多个业务的登录与会话平台，支持验证码或密码登录、会话撤销和权限变更。
functionalRequirements: 提供登录、刷新、退出和多设备会话管理
向业务服务提供可信身份与权限校验契约
处理凭据重置、风险限次、账号冻结和审计
scaleRanges: 1000万–1亿 账号，每日 100万–1000万 登录尝试；登录峰值为平均的 20 倍
鉴权调用峰值 10万–100万 次/秒；活跃会话按 200 B 基础数据/条估算，保留数量需声明
reliabilityConstraints: 鉴权 p99 低于 30 ms 是本地训练目标；撤销与权限变更传播需给出可验证的时间界限
凭据、验证码和令牌不能进入普通日志；依赖故障时须明确拒绝或受限继续服务的策略
deepDiveDirections: 身份、授权、会话存储与业务服务的信任边界
有状态会话与自包含令牌的缓存、撤销和密钥轮换权衡
热点账号攻击、跨区域故障、审计和恢复

en.title: Identity, Sessions and Authorization
en.description: Design a shared login and session platform with password/OTP login, revocation and permission changes.
functionalRequirements: Provide login, refresh, logout and multi-device session management
Provide trusted identity and authorization contracts to application services
Handle credential resets, attempt limits, account suspension and auditing
scaleRanges: 10m–100m accounts and 1m–10m login attempts/day; peak login rate is 20 times average
100k–1m authorization checks/s at peak; estimate 200 B of base data/active session and state retained session counts
reliabilityConstraints: Local target: authorization p99 below 30 ms; define a verifiable propagation bound for revocation and permission changes
Credentials, OTPs and tokens must not enter ordinary logs; define reject-versus-restricted-service behavior during dependency failures
deepDiveDirections: Trust boundaries among identity, authorization, sessions and application services
Stateful sessions versus self-contained tokens: caching, revocation and key rotation
Hot-account attacks, regional failure, audit and recovery

title: 钱包、提现与资金对账
description: 设计钱包记账与提现平台，覆盖冻结、外部打款、结果查询、补偿和对账。
functionalRequirements: 接受经过授权且幂等的记账请求，展示余额和流水
冻结可提现资金，向外部支付机构发起打款并跟踪结果
处理超时未知、失败解冻、重复回调和周期对账
scaleRanges: 1000万 钱包，100万–1000万 次账务操作/日；峰值为平均速率的 20 倍
账务记录按 500 B/条、每次操作 2–4 条记账明细估算，保留 7 年是训练假设
reliabilityConstraints: 金额使用明确币种和最小单位；同一请求不能重复产生资金效果，内部明细需满足记账不变量
外部超时不能直接视为打款失败；需定义未知状态、对账时限和恢复流程
deepDiveDirections: 账本、余额投影、冻结资金与提现状态机的权威边界
外部支付幂等键、状态查询、补偿和对账数据流
热点账户串行化、分片、审计留存与灾难恢复

en.title: Wallets, Withdrawals and Reconciliation
en.description: Design wallet accounting and withdrawals, including holds, external transfers, uncertain outcomes and reconciliation.
functionalRequirements: Accept authorized idempotent accounting requests and show balances and entries
Hold withdrawable funds, initiate external transfers and track their outcomes
Handle unknown timeouts, failed-transfer releases, duplicate callbacks and periodic reconciliation
scaleRanges: 10m wallets and 1m–10m accounting operations/day; peak is 20 times the average
Estimate 500 B/entry and 2–4 entries/operation; seven-year retention is a local training assumption
reliabilityConstraints: Use explicit currencies and minor units; repeated requests must not duplicate monetary effects and entries must preserve accounting invariants
An external timeout is not proof of transfer failure; define unknown states, reconciliation deadlines and recovery
deepDiveDirections: Authority boundaries among ledger, balance projections, holds and withdrawal state machines
External transfer idempotency keys, status queries, compensation and reconciliation flows
Hot-account serialization, partitioning, audit retention and disaster recovery

title: 访问事件与实时 UV 分析
description: 设计多租户访问统计平台，支持事件采集、分时 UV 查询和离线校正。
functionalRequirements: 接收含事件标识、事件时间和租户的访问事件
查询小时、天和自定义窗口的访问量及 UV，声明身份口径和误差
处理重复、迟到、删除请求和历史结果重算
scaleRanges: 每日 1亿–10亿 事件，峰值为平均速率的 10 倍；每条传输记录按 300 B 估算
1万 租户，原始事件保留 30 天，聚合保留 1 年；窗口数与维度数量由候选人明确
reliabilityConstraints: 正常实时结果延迟不超过 60 秒为本地目标；精确和近似查询须明确区分
租户之间不可越权查询，重复和迟到事件的处理须可解释且可重放
deepDiveDirections: 采集、持久日志、流式聚合、查询与离线回放的数据流
去重身份、事件时间窗口、水位线与近似草图的合并边界
高基数维度、热点租户、冷热存储和数据删除传播

en.title: Event Ingestion and Real-Time Visitor Analytics
en.description: Design multi-tenant event collection, windowed unique-visitor queries and offline corrections.
functionalRequirements: Ingest visits with event identity, event time and tenant identity
Query hourly, daily and custom-window views and unique visitors with defined identity and error contracts
Handle duplicates, late events, deletion requests and historical recomputation
scaleRanges: 100m–1bn events/day with 10x peak-to-average rate; estimate 300 B/transmitted event
10k tenants; raw events retained for 30 days and aggregates for one year; state window and dimension counts
reliabilityConstraints: Local target: normal real-time results within 60 seconds; distinguish exact from approximate queries
Enforce tenant query isolation; duplicate and late-event behavior must be explainable and replayable
deepDiveDirections: Collection, durable log, stream aggregation, query and offline replay data flows
Deduplication identity, event-time windows, watermarks and sketch merge boundaries
High-cardinality dimensions, hot tenants, storage tiers and deletion propagation
